## Packages

- Everything so far has been using Base R, which are the default packages that open when RStudio loads
- Packages, aka libraries or modules
- Collection of functions or datasets
- CRAN has the 'official' packages for R
- Environment Tab -\> Global environment shows packages loaded
- First time using a package on a computer you must install it using install.packages(). Can browse on Packages Tab

```{r}
# install.packages("dplyr") # Only needs to be done once
```

- Then you load the package using library(), which must be done each session

```{r}
# library("dplyr")
```

- To list everything in a package use ls():

```{r}
# ls("package:dplyr")
```

- To ensure a function is used from a specific package (in the case the function name exists in multiple packages), use ::

```{r}
# dplyr::filter(iris, Species == "virginica")
```
